critical_path_summary.staffing_implication: Backend Developer and Integration Specialist must be dedicated (not shared) across Phases 1–4; QA Engineer critical in Phases 3–4; Product Manager required for gate reviews and scope decisions.

phases.name: Discovery & Design
milestones: API contract review for all microservices completed
Authentication service integration scope and SLA documented
Gateway architecture and routing rules approved

tasks.name: Conduct microservice inventory audit and document API contracts
tasks.definition_of_done: Inventory of all microservices with endpoint contracts, current API inconsistencies, and versioning status documented and reviewed by Product Manager.

tasks.name: Define authentication service integration scope and validate team experience
tasks.definition_of_done: Authentication mechanism (OAuth2, API keys, mTLS, SSO) selected; auth service SLA and API contract documented; team experience assessment completed.

tasks.name: Confirm sandbox and test environment access for all external services
tasks.definition_of_done: All sandbox credentials provisioned; connectivity tested; environment readiness sign-off obtained.

tasks.name: Review compliance and data retention requirements for logging
tasks.definition_of_done: Compliance scope (SOC2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or standard audit logging) confirmed; data retention policy and PII redaction requirements documented.

tasks.name: Design gateway architecture, routing rules, and load balancing strategy
tasks.definition_of_done: Architecture diagram with routing rules, load balancing strategy (stateless round-robin or least-connections), and rate limiting design approved by team.

phases.name: Core Development
milestones: Sprint 1: Gateway core framework and routing engine implemented
Sprint 3: Rate limiting and load balancing implemented
Sprint 4: Logging pipeline and monitoring setup completed

tasks.name: Set up gateway project structure and select framework (Kong, Envoy, Spring Cloud Gateway, or AWS API Gateway)
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway framework selected and project scaffolding complete; build pipeline and local development environment functional.

tasks.name: Implement core routing engine to forward requests to microservices
tasks.definition_of_done: Routing engine forwards requests to correct microservice based on path and method; basic error handling for missing routes implemented.

tasks.name: Integrate authentication service and implement credential validation
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway validates client credentials against authentication service; unauthorized requests rejected; token caching or session management implemented.

tasks.name: Implement rate limiting logic per client and endpoint
tasks.definition_of_done: Rate limiting enforced per client ID and API endpoint; requests exceeding limit rejected with 429 status; limits configurable.

tasks.name: Implement load balancing across microservice instances
tasks.definition_of_done: Requests distributed across service instances using round-robin or least-connections; health checks detect and exclude unhealthy instances.

tasks.name: Build logging pipeline to capture request/response details
tasks.definition_of_done: All API calls logged with timestamp, client ID, endpoint, status code, and response time; logs sent to centralized logging service; PII redaction applied if required.

tasks.name: Implement API versioning support (header or path-based routing)
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway routes requests to correct API version based on header or path parameter; version mismatch returns appropriate error.

phases.name: Integration & Edge Cases
milestones: Sprint 5: Integration testing with all microservices completed
Sprint 6: Failure scenario and edge case testing completed
Sprint 7: Performance and security testing completed

tasks.name: Test gateway routing with each microservice independently
tasks.definition_of_done: Each microservice endpoint tested individually; routing rules verified; response payloads validated against API contract.

tasks.name: Validate authentication integration with all microservices
tasks.definition_of_done: Authenticated and unauthenticated requests tested; token expiration and refresh tested; authorization rules enforced consistently across all services.

tasks.name: Test rate limiting under load and verify enforcement
tasks.definition_of_done: Rate limits enforced correctly under sustained load; 429 responses returned when limits exceeded; limits reset correctly.

tasks.name: Test load balancing distribution and failover scenarios
tasks.definition_of_done: Requests distributed evenly across instances; unhealthy instances excluded; failover to healthy instances automatic.

tasks.name: Test failure scenarios: external service unavailable, timeout, schema mismatch
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway handles microservice unavailability gracefully; timeout errors logged and returned to client; schema mismatches detected and logged.

tasks.name: Validate logging accuracy and completeness for all request types
tasks.definition_of_done: All API calls logged with correct metadata; no requests missing from logs; PII redaction verified if applicable.

tasks.name: Perform security review: input validation, injection prevention, encryption
tasks.definition_of_done: Input validation implemented for all gateway endpoints; SQL injection and XSS prevention verified; TLS/encryption for all external communication confirmed.

tasks.name: Conduct end-to-end integration test: full request flow from client to microservice and back
tasks.definition_of_done: Complete request flow tested: authentication → routing → rate limiting → load balancing → logging; response returned correctly to client.

phases.name: QA & Testing
milestones: Performance testing under expected load completed
UAT with internal development teams completed

tasks.name: Conduct performance testing: throughput, latency, and resource utilization under expected load
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway handles expected request volume; latency within acceptable range; CPU and memory utilization monitored; bottlenecks identified and documented.

tasks.name: Execute UAT with internal development teams: test gateway with real microservices and workflows
tasks.definition_of_done: Internal teams test gateway with production-like data; feedback collected; critical issues resolved before launch.

tasks.name: Set up monitoring, alerting, and health check dashboards for gateway
tasks.definition_of_done: Monitoring dashboards display gateway metrics (requests/sec, latency, error rate); alerts configured for critical failures; health check endpoint functional.

tasks.name: Write API documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures
tasks.definition_of_done: API documentation includes endpoint specs, authentication requirements, rate limits, and error codes; runbooks cover common operational tasks and troubleshooting.

tasks.name: Resolve critical and high-priority bugs identified during testing
tasks.definition_of_done: All critical bugs fixed and verified; high-priority bugs resolved or documented as known issues; regression testing completed.

tasks.name: Deploy gateway to production environment
tasks.definition_of_done: Gateway deployed to production; all services accessible through gateway; rollback plan tested and ready.

tasks.name: Execute smoke testing in production: verify core routing, authentication, and logging
tasks.definition_of_done: Core gateway functions verified in production; no critical issues detected; logs flowing to centralized logging service.

tasks.name: Obtain go-live sign-off from Product Manager and stakeholders
tasks.definition_of_done: Product Manager and stakeholders confirm gateway is production-ready; sign-off documented; support handoff to operations team completed.
